home.proc04_text: A/B tests, analytics, optimisation. Monthly strategy review. We don't stop at launch.
home.sec05_title: Marketing is not a cost. It's an investment.
home.manif01_text: We won't take a project we can't deliver. No inflated promises — only a clear plan with measurable milestones.
home.manif02_text: We measure success in revenue, ROAS, and NPS — not trophies. Every decision is backed by data.
home.manif03_text: Our average client relationship is 2.4 years. We grow when you grow — that's the only model that makes sense.
home.test1_text: Lumiva didn't just redesign our brand — they rebuilt our entire client acquisition funnel. In six months, lead volume increased by 62%.
home.test2_text: We came with a ROAS of 1.2. They got it to 3.4 in six months. The team lives and breathes data — no guesswork.
home.test3_text: They built a solar panel configurator from scratch. CAC dropped 41% — we hadn't even hoped for that.
home.faq1_q: How do I start working with Lumiva?
home.faq1_a: Fill in the brief below or email vlad@lumiva.agency. We'll respond within one business day. First step is a 45-minute call — no obligations, no agency pitch. Just about your challenge.
home.faq2_a: Minimum project: from €18,000. Full rebrand + performance: €60,000 – €140,000. Monthly retainer: from €14,000/month. We prepare a precise estimate after diagnostics — numbers without context are meaningless.
home.faq3_q: Do you work with small businesses?
home.faq3_a: We work best with companies with €2M+ revenue or startups with confirmed funding. For smaller businesses, we have a 1–3 week sprint format for specific point tasks.
home.faq4_a: Diagnostics, brief, audit, strategy, execution, A/B iterations, analytics. Each stage is on the roadmap — fully transparent. You get a dedicated manager and workspace access, not just monthly reports.
home.faq5_q: What engagement formats do you offer?
home.faq5_a: Three formats: project (6–14 weeks), retainer (3–24 months), and sprint for point tasks (1–3 weeks). We match the format to your stage, not the other way around.

dev.sub: Sites, landings, e-commerce and configurators. From brief to launch.

dev.d01_sub: Promo and presentation sites with CMS
dev.d02_sub: High-load landing pages with A/B infrastructure
dev.proc01_text: Audience, competitor and site analysis. Interactive prototype before design starts — we align on logic, not pixels.
dev.proc02_text: Unique Figma design with components, themes and guidelines. Responsive layout for all resolutions and browsers.
dev.proc03_text: Layout, CMS, API, CRM. Two-week sprints with demos. No black boxes.
dev.proc04_text: Post-launch monitoring, updates, A/B tests. SLA on response time and improvement roadmap.
dev.cta_sub: In 45 minutes we'll map out the challenge, propose a tech stack, and give a timeline and budget estimate
dev.aud1_title: Your current website is slow and hurts conversions
dev.aud1_desc: Every extra second of load time costs you visitors and revenue. We build with performance-first architecture — sub-1.2s LCP on 3G is standard, not an exception.
dev.aud2_title: You need a website that's actually easy to manage
dev.aud2_desc: Many sites are technically impressive but painful to update. We use headless CMS so your team can publish content without touching code.
dev.aud3_title: Your e-commerce platform can't handle your catalogue or traffic
dev.aud3_desc: Off-the-shelf platforms often buckle under large catalogues or traffic spikes. We build custom e-commerce architecture that scales to 50,000–200,000+ SKUs.
dev.aud4_title: You've outgrown no-code tools and need a real product
dev.aud4_desc: No-code platforms are great for MVPs but hit limits fast. We help teams transition to scalable custom applications without losing momentum.
dev.faq1_q: How much does a website cost?
dev.faq1_a: A landing page or lightweight site starts from €1,800 (Sprint tier). A full corporate website or e-commerce platform starts from €12,000 (Project tier). Ongoing development as a dedicated team starts from €2,200/month (Retainer tier).
dev.faq2_a: Sprint projects: up to 4 weeks. Full projects (corporate sites, e-commerce): 6–14 weeks depending on scope. We work in two-week sprints with demos so you see progress continuously.
dev.faq3_a: React, Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS for frontend. Node.js, PostgreSQL, and Redis for backend. Headless CMS (Sanity, Contentful, Strapi). Vercel, AWS, and Cloudflare for infrastructure.
dev.faq4_q: Do you provide support after launch?
dev.faq4_a: Yes. All projects include a support period (1–3 months depending on tier), and we offer ongoing retainers with SLA up to 99.99% uptime for long-term partnerships.
dev.faq5_q: Can you integrate with our existing CRM or ERP?
dev.faq5_a: Yes. We regularly build integrations with CRM, ERP, telephony, and warehouse management systems via REST, GraphQL, or webhook-based connections.
dev.faq6_q: Can you redesign or migrate an existing site?
dev.faq6_a: Yes. We handle full redesigns and platform migrations (e.g. WordPress to Next.js), preserving SEO equity through systematic 301 redirects and content migration.
dev.rel1_desc: Make sure every new page is measurable from day one with proper tracking and attribution.
dev.rel2_desc: Launch a site that's technically solid and visually consistent with a real design system.
dev.rel3_desc: Build SEO foundations into the site from day one instead of retrofitting them later.

design.sec01_sub: Eight design disciplines under one roof
design.d01_sub: Brand strategy, naming, logo system, visual identity, brandbook
design.d04_sub: Brand animations, intro, UI animations, films
design.p01_text: A logo is a starting point. We deliver a complete identity system: strategy, visual language, and all carriers — ready for any medium.
design.p02_text: We measure beauty in metrics. Every design decision is backed by research and validated through testing.
design.p03_text: We begin every project with in-depth research. Only after understanding the audience and market do we open Figma.
design.p04_text: The client is a co-author. We facilitate the creative process so you always know why every visual decision was made.
design.sec03_sub: Prices in EUR. Base identity or full system — we match to the task.
design.cta_sub: Tell us about your product and audience
design.aud1_title: Your brand looks inconsistent across channels
design.aud1_desc: Different fonts, colours, and tone on your site, socials, and print materials confuse customers and dilute trust. We build one system that holds together everywhere.
design.aud2_title: Your logo doesn't scale beyond a business card
design.aud2_desc: A logo that breaks on a favicon, a billboard, or a mobile app icon isn't a real identity system. We design logo systems built for every surface from day one.
design.aud3_title: You're rebranding but don't know where to start
design.aud3_desc: Rebrands fail when they start with the logo instead of the strategy. We begin with positioning and audience research, then build the visual system to match.
design.aud4_title: Your product UI looks dated next to competitors
design.aud4_desc: An outdated interface signals an outdated product, even if the tech underneath is solid. We design UI systems that look and feel current and convert better.
design.faq1_q: How much does brand identity cost?
design.faq1_a: A core Identity package starts from €4,500 (logo system, visual identity, digital brandbook). A full Brand System with strategy and naming starts from €14,000. Ongoing creative partnership starts from €3,500/month.
design.faq2_q: How long does a full rebrand take?
design.faq2_a: A core Identity package takes 5–6 weeks. A full Brand System (strategy, naming, identity, UI kit, packaging, motion) takes 10–14 weeks. We work in weekly review cycles so you see direction early.
design.faq3_q: What's included in the Brand System package?
design.faq3_a: Strategy and naming, complete visual identity, a UI kit or design system, packaging and print templates, motion guidelines, and a full brandbook delivered as PDF, Figma, and print-ready files.
design.faq4_q: Do you do naming as well as visual identity?
design.faq4_a: Yes. Naming is included in the Brand System and Creative Partner tiers — we run structured naming workshops alongside trademark screening recommendations.
design.faq5_q: Can you design packaging and print alongside digital?
design.faq5_a: Yes. Our team covers packaging, print, editorial, motion, and environmental design alongside digital identity, so the same system carries across every physical and digital touchpoint.
design.faq6_q: Will we get source files and a usable brand guideline?
design.faq6_a: Yes. Every project delivers editable source files (Figma, Adobe) plus a brandbook your team can use independently for future materials without needing us for every asset.
design.rel1_desc: Bring the identity system to life on a fast, well-built website.
design.rel2_desc: Keep visual consistency across every piece of content your brand produces.
design.rel3_desc: Apply the new identity system consistently across every social channel.

analytics.title: Analytics your CFO can trust
analytics.sub: End-to-end attribution, product analytics, BI dashboards
analytics.a01_sub: Full path from first touch to sale. Custom models for offline conversions.
analytics.a03_sub: Real-time dashboards for marketing, product, and C-suite
analytics.a05_sub: Churn models, LTV forecasting, recommendation systems, dynamic pricing
analytics.a06_sub: Data warehouse, ETL pipelines, event tracking, CDP
analytics.cta_sub: In 48 hours we'll show you exactly where your analytics is losing data
analytics.aud1_title: Your marketing and sales data live in different systems
analytics.aud1_desc: Disconnected data makes it impossible to see the real ROI of each channel. We build a unified data warehouse that connects ad platforms, CRM, and revenue data.
analytics.aud2_title: You can't tell which campaigns actually drive paying customers
analytics.aud2_desc: Click-based metrics don't show real business impact. Our end-to-end attribution model tracks the full path from first touch to closed deal, including offline conversions.
analytics.aud3_title: Your team makes decisions on gut feeling, not data
analytics.aud3_desc: Without reliable dashboards, even experienced teams default to intuition. We build BI dashboards that surface the metrics that matter to marketing, product, and leadership.
analytics.aud4_title: You're losing customers but don't know why
analytics.aud4_desc: Churn often has identifiable patterns. We build ML-based churn prediction models that flag at-risk customers before they leave, so your team can act in time.
analytics.faq1_q: What's included in the analytics audit?
analytics.faq1_a: The audit reviews your GA4 or Yandex Metrica setup, checks attribution accuracy, identifies tracking gaps, and delivers a 90-day priority list. Delivered within 2 weeks for €3,500.
analytics.faq2_q: Do we need a data warehouse?
analytics.faq2_a: If you're combining data from multiple sources (ads, CRM, product, finance) for reporting, a data warehouse pays off quickly. For simpler setups, a well-configured GA4 + BI dashboard may be sufficient — we'll recommend based on your audit.
analytics.faq3_q: What tools do you work with?
analytics.faq3_a: GA4, Yandex Metrica, Amplitude, Mixpanel, Tableau, Looker, Metabase, Power BI, Python, dbt, and Spark for data engineering and ML work.
analytics.faq4_q: How accurate is your attribution model?
analytics.faq4_a: We build custom attribution models tailored to your sales cycle and channel mix, including handling for offline conversions. Accuracy depends on data completeness — we're transparent about confidence levels in every report.
analytics.faq5_q: Can you set up analytics for a new website from scratch?
analytics.faq5_a: Yes. We can set up basic GA4/Metrica tracking within days, and a full analytics stack (warehouse, attribution, dashboards) typically within 4–8 weeks.
analytics.faq6_q: Do you provide ongoing support after setup?
analytics.faq6_a: Yes, via our Data Partner retainer — a dedicated analyst and data engineer providing monthly insights, A/B test support, and infrastructure maintenance with a 99.9% SLA.
analytics.rel1_desc: Measure the real contribution of organic traffic to pipeline and revenue, not just sessions.
analytics.rel2_desc: Feed attribution data straight back into campaign optimisation across every paid channel.
analytics.rel3_desc: Pipe verified analytics data directly into your CRM, ERP, or BI stack.

performance.cta_title: Find out where you're losing money right now
performance.cta_sub: Free audit of your current campaigns
performance.aud1_title: You don't know which channel actually drives revenue
performance.aud1_desc: Without proper attribution, you're optimising budget based on guesses, not data. We build attribution models that show the real path from ad click to closed deal.
performance.aud2_title: Your cost per lead keeps rising
performance.aud2_desc: Rising CPLs often mean audience fatigue or poor account structure. We restructure campaigns and testing cadence to bring costs back down — our clients see an average 55% reduction.
performance.aud3_title: You're stuck on one or two ad channels
performance.aud3_desc: Relying on a single channel caps your growth and increases risk. We diversify across Google, Meta, programmatic, and CRM to build a resilient acquisition mix.
performance.aud4_desc: Many businesses see returns drop sharply when they increase budget. Our media planning and creative testing process is built specifically to scale spend while protecting ROAS.
performance.faq1_q: How much budget do I need to start with performance marketing?
performance.faq1_a: We recommend a minimum media budget of €2,000–€3,000/month to gather statistically significant data, in addition to our management fee starting from €1,200/month for the Launch tier.
performance.faq2_q: What's the difference between your tiers?
performance.faq2_a: Launch covers 1–3 channels with basic reporting. Growth adds CRM integration, full attribution, and multi-channel strategy across 4–6 channels. Scale includes programmatic, a dedicated team, and ML-based forecasting.
performance.faq3_q: How fast can I expect results?
performance.faq3_a: Initial data and optimisation signals appear within 2–4 weeks. Stable ROAS improvements (3x or more) typically emerge within 8–12 weeks as we iterate through testing cycles.
performance.faq4_q: Do you manage the ad spend or just the strategy?
performance.faq4_a: We manage campaigns end-to-end: strategy, setup, creative briefing, daily optimisation, and reporting. You retain full ownership and visibility of ad accounts and budgets at all times.
performance.faq5_q: Can you work alongside our in-house marketing team?
performance.faq5_a: Yes. We frequently work as an extension of in-house teams, taking ownership of specific channels or providing strategic oversight while your team handles execution.
performance.faq6_q: What platforms do you advertise on?
performance.faq6_a: Google Ads (Search, Display, Shopping, Performance Max), Meta Ads, TikTok, LinkedIn, programmatic display networks, and Yandex Direct for CIS markets.
performance.rel1_desc: Stop sending paid traffic to slow generic pages — convert more of what you're already paying for.
performance.rel2_desc: See the full path from ad click to closed deal with end-to-end attribution.
performance.rel3_desc: Reduce reliance on paid spend over time by building a compounding organic channel.

seo.cta_title: Find out why you're not found in search
seo.cta_sub: Free express audit — we'll show 3 key issues in 15 minutes
seo.aud1_title: Your revenue depends entirely on paid ads
seo.aud1_desc: Every lead costs you money, every month, forever. SEO turns a one-time investment into a channel that keeps generating traffic without paying per click.
seo.aud2_title: Competitors outrank you for keywords that should be yours
seo.aud2_desc: If competitors show up first for queries with buying intent, you're losing customers before they ever see your site.
seo.aud3_title: Your site isn't indexed properly by Google
seo.aud3_desc: Slow load times, broken structured data, and crawl errors quietly block your pages from ranking at all.
seo.aud4_title: Previous SEO efforts didn't show measurable results
seo.aud4_desc: Generic SEO without a clear strategy wastes budget. We build a measurable roadmap tied to traffic, leads, and revenue — not just rankings.
seo.faq1_a: SEO projects start from €1,500 for a one-time audit. Ongoing SEO management starts from €3,000/month for the Growth tier, and from €6,000/month for a dedicated SEO team. The exact cost depends on your site size, competition, and target markets.
seo.faq2_q: How long does SEO take to show results?
seo.faq2_a: Technical fixes and quick wins can show impact within 4–8 weeks. For competitive commercial keywords, expect meaningful ranking improvements within 3–6 months, with compounding growth after that.
seo.faq3_a: No agency can honestly guarantee specific rankings — Google's algorithm changes constantly. What we guarantee is a transparent, data-driven process, monthly reporting, and a track record of +340% average organic growth across our portfolio.
seo.faq4_q: What's included in the technical audit?
seo.faq4_a: Our technical audit covers 200+ factors: site speed, Core Web Vitals, crawlability, indexation status, structured data, mobile usability, internal linking, and a prioritised list of fixes ranked by impact.
seo.faq5_q: Do you write the content, or do we need our own writers?
seo.faq5_a: We write SEO content as part of the Growth and Scale tiers — articles, landing pages, and category pages targeting your priority keyword clusters. You can also provide your own content for us to optimise.
seo.faq6_q: Can you do SEO in multiple languages?
seo.faq6_a: Yes. We run multilingual SEO programmes in English, Russian, and Turkish, with separate keyword research, hreflang implementation, and localised content for each market.
seo.rel1_desc: Track organic traffic, rankings, and revenue impact in one dashboard alongside your other channels.
seo.rel2_desc: Combine long-term organic growth with paid campaigns to fill the gap while SEO compounds.
seo.rel3_desc: SEO needs a steady stream of content — we produce the articles and pages your strategy targets.

smm.aud2_title: You're posting content but it's not driving sales
smm.aud2_desc: Content without a funnel is just entertainment. We connect every post to a path toward inquiry, purchase, or booking — with tracked links and clear CTAs.
smm.aud3_title: You don't have time to manage multiple platforms
smm.aud3_desc: Consistent posting across Telegram, Instagram, YouTube, and influencer channels takes a dedicated team. We run the full production and publishing calendar for you.
smm.aud4_title: Influencer campaigns haven't delivered measurable ROI
smm.aud4_desc: Without clear briefs and tracking, influencer spend is a gamble. We select creators based on audience fit, set measurable KPIs, and report on actual reach and conversions.
smm.faq1_a: Content Production without channel management starts from €4,000/month. Full SMM management (production + posting + community) starts from €7,000/month. Full Cycle with influence and PR starts from €15,000/month.
smm.faq2_q: How quickly will we see follower or engagement growth?
smm.faq2_a: Initial engagement improvements from content and posting changes appear within 4–6 weeks. Sustained follower growth typically builds over 3–6 months as content and distribution compound.
smm.faq3_q: Do you create the content or just manage posting?
smm.faq3_a: Both. Our Production and SMM Full tiers include content creation (video, photo, copy) as well as scheduling, posting, and community management across your channels.
smm.faq4_a: Telegram, Instagram, YouTube, and influencer/PR campaigns. We tailor the channel mix to where your specific audience is most active.
smm.faq5_a: Yes. We handle creator selection, briefing, native integrations, ambassador programmes, and UGC campaigns, with effectiveness measurement on every campaign.
smm.faq6_q: How do you measure SMM success?
smm.faq6_a: Engagement rate, follower growth quality (not just volume), click-through to owned channels, and — where relevant — leads or sales attributed to social campaigns via UTM tracking.
smm.rel1_desc: Source consistent, high-quality content from a dedicated production team.
smm.rel2_desc: Keep every post visually consistent with your brand identity.
smm.rel3_desc: Amplify your best-performing posts with targeted paid campaigns.

ecommerce.d4_desc: OZON, Wildberries, Yandex Market — unified catalog, auto-feed, per-channel analytics in one interface.

ecommerce.aud1_title: Your store can't handle your catalogue size
ecommerce.aud1_desc: Off-the-shelf platforms often slow down or break past a few thousand SKUs. We build catalogue architecture that scales cleanly to 50,000–200,000+ products.
ecommerce.aud2_title: Your checkout abandons customers before they pay
ecommerce.aud2_desc: Slow checkout flows and limited payment options lose sales at the final step. We optimise checkout speed and integrate local payment methods customers actually trust.
ecommerce.aud3_title: You need marketplace integrations your current platform can't do
ecommerce.aud3_desc: Selling on OZON, Wildberries, or Yandex Market alongside your own store requires synced inventory and orders. We build the integrations that keep everything in sync automatically.
ecommerce.aud4_title: Your store isn't connected to a real CRM
ecommerce.aud4_desc: Without CRM integration, customer data and order history live in silos. We connect your store to Lumiva CRM or your existing system so sales, support, and marketing share one source of truth.
ecommerce.faq1_q: How much does an e-commerce store cost?
ecommerce.faq1_a: A standard online store starts from €5,000. A full-featured platform with marketplace integrations and CRM starts from €18,000. Ongoing development as a dedicated team starts from €3,500/month.
ecommerce.faq2_q: How long does it take to launch an online store?
ecommerce.faq2_a: A standard store launches in 6–10 weeks. A full platform with marketplace integrations and custom CRM connectivity typically takes 10–14 weeks depending on catalogue complexity.
ecommerce.faq3_q: Can you handle large product catalogues?
ecommerce.faq3_a: Yes. Our architecture (Elasticsearch for search, PostgreSQL and Redis for data and caching) is built to handle catalogues from a few hundred to 200,000+ SKUs without performance degradation.
ecommerce.faq4_q: Which payment systems do you integrate?
ecommerce.faq4_a: Stripe and PayPal for international payments, plus YuKassa, Tinkoff Pay, SBP, and PayKeeper for the Russian and CIS market. We can add other local payment providers depending on your target market.
ecommerce.faq5_q: Can you integrate with marketplaces like OZON or Wildberries?
ecommerce.faq5_a: Yes. We build native integrations with OZON, Wildberries, Yandex Market, plus logistics providers like CDEK and Boxberry, syncing inventory and orders automatically.
ecommerce.faq6_q: Does the store come with CRM out of the box?
ecommerce.faq6_a: We integrate Lumiva CRM or your existing CRM (1C:Trade, Bitrix24, amoCRM) directly into the store, so every order, customer, and support ticket flows into one system.
ecommerce.rel1_desc: Drive consistent traffic and sales to your new store across every channel.
ecommerce.rel2_desc: Track revenue, average order value, and attribution end-to-end across your store.
ecommerce.rel3_desc: Launch fast, focused campaign pages for product drops and promotions.

landings.faq1_a: A single conversion-focused landing page starts from €1,800. A campaign system with multiple page variants and A/B testing starts from €5,500. Ongoing optimisation as a retainer starts from €1,500/month.
landings.faq2_q: How fast can you launch a landing page?
landings.faq2_a: A standard landing page launches in around 10 days from approved copy and design direction. Rush timelines are possible for an additional fee depending on scope.
landings.faq3_a: Yes, A/B testing infrastructure (PostHog, GrowthBook, or VWO) is included in the Campaign System and Optimisation tiers, so you can test headlines, hero sections, and CTAs with statistically valid results.
landings.faq4_q: Will the landing page integrate with our CRM?

landings.faq5_q: How fast do your landing pages load?
landings.faq5_a: We target sub-0.8s LCP using WebP/AVIF images, critical CSS, and edge deployment on Vercel or Cloudflare. Page speed is treated as a conversion factor, not an afterthought.
